_readme: CBFC's look for a team member's office: the install line adds it with --brand cbfc. It follows the CBFC Academy: its colours, its charcoal bar and paper page (look academy), light only, and its own fonts and logo. The fonts and logo are not in this public repo: they are read from the CBFC Academy on that computer (installed on its own, in the home folder), so the office uses system fonts and the WorkSpace orb until the Academy is there.
